name: Marketaux
rate_limits: Free plan: 100 requests a day, 3 articles per request (source: https://www.marketaux.com/pricing).
history_start: Not stated on the pricing page.
what_it_has: Financial news tagged by entity, including currencies, with a sentiment score from -1 to +1 for each entity. Time series stats need a paid plan.
simple: A financial news service that marks each story as good or bad for the companies or currencies it mentions.
license_terms: See Marketaux terms; the pricing page does not spell out free plan usage limits beyond volume. https://www.marketaux.com/pricing
quality_notes: 300 articles a day is too thin for a signal. Sentiment model is not documented in detail.

relevance.reason: Currency tagged sentiment, but the free volume is too small.
